matches.rationale: Both findings identify that the Bregman divergence definition in §2.3 has its arguments (y and p) transposed relative to the standard definition, matching the mechanism of GT1; pred1 formally refutes Lemma 2.1 under this definition and pred2 documents the cross-section contradictions this creates.
Pred3 directly identifies the reversed inequality in the strong convexity definition and uses Lean to refute the consequence drawn from it, matching GT2's mechanism exactly.
Pred8 identifies the spurious 1/T normalization factor inserted into the calibration error definition in §2.1 and shows it contradicts every other unnormalized usage in the paper, matching GT3.
